purpose: tier1_v2 cross-check batch on bio-lab: quantify 14 single-end samples through the public CLI (expression.quantify.v1) with the upstream salmon 2.7.0 index and parameters, and compare against the upstream's stored quant.sf. Row parity and NumReads totals pass on all 14. POST-HOC CORRECTION (upstream verified): the reference is upstream salmon 2.7.0 (official ELF binary, not a re-implementation); the near-zero mapping (both implementations independently measure ~0-0.0019%) is a property of the DATA - these 14 runs are small-RNA/special libraries with nothing to map against an mRNA CDS index. They are excluded: non-mRNA library, and belong to the miRNA pipeline once a miRBase reference is available.

methodology.disclosure: single cold-cache cross-check run per sample; the 14 runs are excluded: non-mRNA library (near-zero mapping confirmed independently by both implementations)
